units.source_text: 在靠近屋檐前的地方，整齐地立着一排圆木，二楼也立着一排。

en.t: Near the eaves, a row of round logs stood neatly upright, and another row stood on the second floor.

units.source_text: 有一处人家，二楼那排圆木前面，晾晒着汗衫等衣物。

en.t: At one house, undershirts and other clothes were hanging out to dry in front of the row of logs on the second floor.
